pay_detail: Not a job. Many high schools pay the cost, but it varies. The FAQ says financial aid is not available for dual credit students. Textbooks are loaned.
duration: Mostly a full school year; classes 7:30 to 9:30 am on Parkland days
name: Early College and Career Academy (ECCA)
org: Education for Employment System #330 and Parkland College
what_you_do: High school juniors and seniors take career classes at Parkland College (such as automotive, nursing assistant, computer programming, construction trades or EMS) and earn high school and college credit. Classes are in early morning.
who_can_apply: Any junior or senior in the Parkland College district. Home school and private school students can apply through the ECCA office.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Admitted students meet in May for summer orientation.
how_to_apply: Ask your high school counselor for the ECCA application, apply to Parkland as an Early College student if needed, and return the ECCA form with a parent signature to your counselor. Call 217-355-1382 or email nelder@efe.k12.il.us.
notes: Students need their own ride to Parkland and to off-campus clinical or job-site visits. ECCA follows the Parkland calendar, not the high school calendar.
